claim: The Organizations quota page lists 40,000 characters as the maximum size of the resource-based delegation policy; it calls these values default maximums and says you can request increases for some of them.

qualifiers.condition: listed among default maximums; increases can be requested for some of these values

evidence.quote: | Maximum size of the resource-based delegation policy |  40,000 characters |
The following are the ***default*** maximums for entities in AWS Organizations.
